entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
4.0.360.0

4.0.360.0 (2026-10-28 18:11 UTC)

  • Artifact (4.0.103.0)
    • Update support mode for Assurance Assistance
  • CertificateManager (4.0.103.0)
    • AWS Certificate Manager now supports the Automatic Certificate Management Environment (ACME) protocol in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) Regions.
  • Connect (4.0.128.0)
    • Amazon Connect APIs - CreateTaskTemplate and UpdateTaskTemplate accept a new ContactHooks parameter called WrapUpFlowId to identify the flow module that runs when an agent attempts to disconnect from a task created with the template. Use this to verify an agent's work or update external case repos.
  • ConnectParticipant (4.0.101.0)
    • Amazon Connect Participant Service now supports the optional UrlContentDisposition parameter on GetAttachment, which returns a pre-signed URL that renders a chat attachment inline in the browser instead of forcing a download.
  • EC2 (4.0.131.0)
    • Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager adds supportability checks and capacity fulfillment metrics. Use GetCapacityManagerSupportabilityScores to score how well instance types and Availability Zones can support a capacity request, and GetCapacityManagerMetricData to retrieve fulfillment metrics.
  • IVS (4.0.103.0)
    • InsertAdBreak now allows setting a customized adBreakId on a request and also adds a new field targetStartAt for a delayed ad insertion
  • KafkaConnect (4.0.103.0)
    • Amazon MSK Connect now supports updating a connector's custom plugin and worker configuration via the UpdateConnector API. MSK Connect checks connector and task health after the update and rolls back on failure. Each call returns an operation ARN to track with DescribeConnectorOperation.
  • MediaLive (4.0.108.0)
    • AWS Elemental MediaLive now supports SMPTE 2022-7 seamless protection switching for multicast inputs on MediaLive Anywhere. Support for MulticastSettings sources to add a redundant copy of the stream received on a second network interface.
  • Neptunedata (4.0.101.0)
    • Get Storage API analyzes storage usage to identify database bloat and your storage footprint. Index Rebuild API triggers on-demand index reconstruction to eliminate bloat and restore query performance.
  • OpenSearchService (4.0.106.0)
    • This release adds APIs to simplify setting up a replication relationship between OpenSearch clusters. The APIs include new Switchover and Failover actions for planned switchovers and unplanned failovers to ensure high availability for OpenSearch in the event of disaster in a single region.
  • SecurityAgent (4.0.114.0)
    • Adds support for attaching client certificates for mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication to penetration test target endpoints via the new ClientCertificates field on Assets, enabling pentesting of endpoints that require client certificate authentication.

entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.Network_1.18.0-beta.2

1.18.0-beta.2 (2026-10-28)

The changes below are described relative to version 1.15.0. Previously published releases after 1.15.0, including 1.16.1 and 1.17.0, are planned for retraction.

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version from 2025-05-01 to 2026-01-01.
  • Added resource APIs for address prefix sets, connection analyzers, connection policies, ExpressRoute LAGs, firewall policy Kubernetes selector groups, identity integration authentication policies, interconnect groups, and network manager configuration commits.
  • Added models for Application Gateway advanced routing conditions, maps, and rules.
  • Added strongly typed BastionHostPatch overloads to BastionHostResource.Update and UpdateAsync.

Breaking Changes

  • This release contains breaking changes compared with versions 1.16.1 and 1.17.0.

Other Changes

  • Migrated code generation from AutoRest to TypeSpec.
  • Deprecated PolicySettings.CaptchaCookieExpirationInMins in favor of CaptchaExpirationInMins and hid the legacy property from IntelliSense. The legacy property forwards to the replacement property for serialization.

Azure.ResourceManager.NetApp_1.19.0

1.19.0 (2026-10-20)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-08-01.
  • Expanded LdapConfiguration and LdapConfigurationPatch with bind authentication, DNS servers, distinguished names, LDAP port, and Key Vault-backed bind password settings.
  • Added BindPasswordKeyVaultConfig and BindPasswordKeyVaultConfigPatch models.
  • Added BindAuthenticationLevel and SecureLdapType enums for LDAP authentication and secure LDAP configuration.
  • Added the Canceled member to NetAppProvisioningState.
  • Added RefreshLdapBindPassword and RefreshLdapBindPasswordAsync operations to NetAppAccountResource.

Bugs Fixed

  • Preserved the existing NetAppAccountPatch.Encryption and NetAppAccountPatch.ActiveDirectories property types and NfsV4IdDomain property name when generating from TypeSpec.
  • Preserved explicit-null NFSv4 ID domain updates and their serialization round-trips.
  • Restored mutable empty tags when Elastic resource model factories receive omitted or null tags.
  • Restored collection interface enumeration through overridden listing methods, including cancellation-token forwarding.

Azure.ResourceManager.OracleDatabase_1.3.0

1.3.0 (2026-10-16)

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version to 2026-06-01.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed hostname deserialization for cloud VM clusters.
  • Fixed base database model factories to return concrete mock instances while preserving discriminator values.

entry.title: dotnet/orleans - Releases - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
v10.4.1

Orleans 10.4.1

Orleans 10.4.1 improves cluster membership, grain scheduling, graceful shutdown, client startup, serialization, and provider reliability. It also restores standalone serializer code generation, fixes ADO.NET streaming message loss, and improves dashboard statistics and navigation.

Compatibility and upgrade notes

Important

Public API compatibility: SiloAddress.GetUniformHashCodes(int) now returns ImmutableArray<uint> instead of uint[]. This is a source- and binary-breaking change for code which calls this method. Rebuild affected applications and libraries against 10.4.1. Use ToArray() when a mutable array is required, or Sort() for an immutable sorted result. See #11425.

  • Distributed grain directory: Preserve the cluster's existing partition count and ordered partition boundaries throughout an upgrade. The new GrainDirectoryOptions.GetPartitionBoundaries callback supports configuring the mapping used by an existing cluster, including the older sorted-hash mapping. Partition defaults remain unchanged. See #11425.
  • Management deactivation: Begin using the new IManagementGrain.DeactivateGrain operation after all active silos have been upgraded to support it. See #11483.
  • Custom consistent-ring configurations: Clusters using UseVirtualBucketsConsistentRing = false receive corrected request routing. During a rolling upgrade, older callers can still route reminder operations to the wrong owner. Persisted reminders are reconciled on the owner's next successful refresh, which defaults to five minutes; early occurrences can be missed before reconciliation. Custom grain services using this ring need application-specific upgrade handling. The default virtual-buckets provider retains its existing behavior. See #11598.

What's changed

The release preparation PR, #11566, bundles multiple backports. Those changes are expanded below, with links to their original PRs alongside the subsequent 10.x fixes.

Grain execution and graceful shutdown

  • Preserve read-only scheduling isolation. Request admission accounts for every active request's interleaving policy, keeping writable requests isolated from active [ReadOnly] requests and correctly handling mixed MayInterleave workloads. #10809
  • Make grain timer scheduling consistent. Timer ticks coalesce while a callback is queued or running, delayed wakeups are preserved, and Change calls made during that interval apply the latest schedule after the callback completes. #11464
  • Carry queued requests with migrating activations. Graceful silo retirement and explicit activation migration transfer eligible queued requests through normal destination admission. Best-effort caller retargeting reduces SiloUnavailableException failures when a retiring silo departs, while preserving callers' original deadlines. Applications should continue to account for ambiguous outcomes when an acceptance acknowledgement is lost. #11460
  • Run observer-level incoming call filters. Filters implemented by observer objects participate in incoming call processing. #11507
  • Safely deactivate existing grain instances. IManagementGrain.DeactivateGrain(GrainId, CancellationToken) locates existing activations directly and waits for their deactivation callbacks. This supports lifecycle operations on grains whose persisted state cannot currently be read. #11483

Cluster membership, directories, and Kubernetes

  • Preserve the default grain directory when registering a named distributed directory. Grains continue to use their configured directory, fixing duplicate activations caused by the registration interaction. #11553
  • Keep membership snapshots canonical and retain departed-silo knowledge. Local startup lifecycle tracking remains separate from published membership rows. Retained death information lets client routing and durable-job adoption account for silos after their rows are pruned. Snapshot decoding also supports older silos which omit the new history field. #11593
  • Improve membership health monitoring. Health monitors handle shutdown cancellation cleanly, and joining silos reevaluate stale peers. #11421, #11431
  • Upgrade legacy Azure Table membership data safely. Existing legacy tables can be read with their versions and ETags intact. The first successful membership write atomically establishes the snapshot boundary markers, and reads retry when they overlap marker installation. #11596
  • Read Firestore membership rows atomically. The silo row and membership version are read from the same transactional snapshot during concurrent updates. #11400
  • Route Redis membership and directory operations to the primary. Primary routing provides current membership and registration state and avoids replica write failures during reconnection. #11484
  • Keep elected Kubernetes agents monitoring. Membership updates preserve the elected agent's pod watch and dead-silo pod cleanup; election handoffs and shutdown coordinate pending monitor wakeups. #11600
  • Update KubernetesClient to 21.0.8, with a supported dependency range of [21.0.8,22.0.0). #11503
  • Align consistent-ring routing with published ownership ranges, including unsigned hash positions, range endpoints, and wraparound. #11598

Client startup and storage cancellation

  • Honor client startup cancellation throughout initialization. Cancellation reaches gateway-provider initialization, discovery, connection attempts, retry decisions, and initial cluster-manifest retrieval. A cancelled start releases owned startup resources before completing. After successful startup, background refreshes follow the client's lifetime token. Existing gateway providers remain supported through default implementations of the new cancellation-aware methods. #11605
  • Forward storage cancellation tokens through ADO.NET, Azure Blob, Azure Table, Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, and Firestore grain storage operations. #11410, #11411, #11412, #11413, #11414, #11415

Serialization and packaging

  • Restore standalone serializer code generation. Projects referencing Microsoft.Orleans.Serialization receive the transitive source-generator and analyzer dependencies needed for [GenerateSerializer] types, fixing runtime CodecNotFoundException failures caused by missing generated codecs. #11603
  • Deserialize empty multidimensional arrays correctly. #11430
  • Enforce Arc buffer bounds and lifetime rules. Fixes cover empty buffers, page-backed slices, disposal checks, consecutive empty pages, and nested reader forks. #11474
  • Tighten type resolution and authorization. Assembly-qualified lookup respects the specified assembly, and generic type definitions require their own authorization while explicit argument denials remain authoritative. #11456
  • Update MessagePack to 3.1.11, incorporating nested-array, regex backtracking, and LZ4 integer-overflow security fixes. #11519

Streaming

  • Prevent ADO.NET stream message loss during out-of-order dequeue and redelivery. Cache sequence tokens follow dequeue positions, keeping older or redelivered messages reachable by consumers. Confirmation batches deduplicate message IDs and retain the highest dequeue count. The fix uses the existing database schema and SQL scripts. #11527
  • Give each Event Hubs buffer pool a unique monitoring identity. Each cache factory retains its pool ID across partitions and cache recreation, while separate factories receive distinct IDs. #11601

Dashboard, samples, and release infrastructure

  • Restore dashboard silo statistics and counter refresh. Connected-client counts come from the gateway, byte totals come from dashboard-collected metrics, and counters refresh on the dashboard interval. Narrow-screen navigation gains an accessible sidebar toggle and keyboard dismissal. #11493
  • Update repository and sample dependencies, including patched cryptography dependencies for SqlClient-based tests and benchmarks, and simplify the ChatRoom sample's dependencies. #11497, #11519, #11445
  • Refresh package-validation and documentation-build configuration, extend CI coverage to the 10.x maintenance branch, and install a supported NuGet client for API-key publishing. #11566, #11619

Full changelog: v10.4.0...v10.4.1

entry.title: dotnet/SqlClient - Releases - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
Stable Release v6.1.8

This update brings the following changes since the 6.1.7 release:

Changed

  • Updated the System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs dependency to 8.0.2 (was 8.0.1) for .NET Framework 4.6.2, .NET 8.0, and .NET Standard 2.0, and updated the Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory, System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager, and System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs dependencies to 9.0.21 (was 9.0.11) for .NET 9.0.
    (#4842, #4862, #4870)

  • Improved the error reported when Active Directory Interactive authentication through the Windows Web Account Manager (WAM) broker fails because the host has no parent window, such as a service or Azure Functions host. The resulting error now explains the supported alternatives: supply a parent window with SetParentActivityOrWindowFunc, use Active Directory Default with a configured non-interactive credential, or supply a custom ApplicationClientId with UseWamBroker disabled. The original MSAL error code and inner exception are preserved, and authentication selection, retry behavior, and other failures are unchanged. (Windows only)
    (#4854, #4858, #4918)

Fixed

  • Fixed the managed SNI path ignoring HostNameInCertificate during server certificate validation. When HostNameInCertificate is set, it is now the only host name the server certificate is validated against, and certificates that do not match it are rejected. Default host-name selection when the property is not set, certificate chain validation, ServerCertificate matching, and the connection destination are unchanged. (net8.0/net9.0 only)
    (#4905, #4909)

  • Fixed Always Encrypted enclave session caching so that cached enclave sessions are isolated by attestation protocol. A session established with one Attestation Protocol setting is no longer reused by a connection to the same server, database, and attestation URL that uses a different protocol.
    (#4829, #4868)

  • Fixed SqlDataReader.HasRows returning false when a result set contains rows but the server sends multiple informational messages, or an informational message before an ORDER token, ahead of the first row. Empty results still report false, and InfoMessage delivery is unchanged.
    (#3018, #4773, #4898)

  • Fixed an intermittent InvalidOperationException ("Nullable object must have a value") from statistics bookkeeping when commands complete concurrently on a MARS connection. This issue was reported as a regression starting with 6.1.4.
    (#4778, #4875, #4896)

  • Fixed Entra ID authentication when the server supplies an authority URL with an OAuth endpoint suffix, such as https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/oauth2/authorize returned by the Dataverse/Dynamics 365 TDS endpoint. The provider now extracts the tenant from the first path segment and uses the normalized authority for Azure.Identity credentials, MSAL, and their cache keys. An authority URL that cannot be parsed now fails with a clear, localized ArgumentException naming the authority. Bare tenant authority URLs used by Azure SQL and Fabric retain their existing behavior.
    (#4496, #4521, #4791, #4807)

Target Platform Support

  • .NET Framework 4.6.2+ (Windows x86, Windows x64, Windows ARM64)
  • .NET 8.0+ (Windows x86, Windows x64, Windows ARM64, Linux, macOS)
  • .NET Standard 2.0+ (Windows x86, Windows x64, Windows ARM64, Linux, macOS)

Full details: release-notes/6.1/6.1.8.md

entry.title: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet - Releases - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
core-1.21.0-rc.1

The following changes are from the previous release 1.20.1.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Fixed a race in the self-diagnostics sink dispatcher where disposing it
      while its pump thread was exiting could throw ArgumentNullException on
      .NET Framework.
      (#7983)

    • SelfDiagnosticsOptions is now automatically bound from the
      OpenTelemetry:SelfDiagnostics configuration section, when present.
      (#8008)

    • Fixed a race where collecting a metric with delta temporality concurrently
      with the creation of a new MetricPoint could reclaim the MetricPoint
      while it was being created, losing the measurement.
      (#8019)

    • Fixed a race where collecting a metric with delta temporality could export
      the same series twice in a single collection.
      (#8019)

    • Fixed wildcard matching timeouts that could prevent configured source, meter,
      legacy activity, or metric view patterns from matching.
      (#8014)

    • The timeout passed to MetricReader.Collect() (for example by
      MeterProvider.ForceFlush()), the ExportTimeoutMilliseconds of
      PeriodicExportingMetricReader and the ExporterTimeoutMilliseconds of
      BatchExportProcessor<T> are now made available to the exporter instead of
      being ignored once the export has started, so that the OTLP exporter can
      cancel an export which runs past the timeout. The ExportTimeoutMilliseconds
      of PeriodicExportingMetricReader now also limits exports which are not
      started by the reader itself, such as those of MeterProvider.ForceFlush().
      (#7996)

    • Fixed a race where collecting a cumulative metric concurrently with the
      creation of a new MetricPoint could export a MetricPoint that was not yet
      fully initialized, could case a NullReferenceException when enumerating Tags.
      (#8018)

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    • Added support for enabling ActivitySources from configuration using the
      Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics tracing APIs introduced in .NET 11 (for
      example, services.AddTracing(b => b.AddConfiguration(section))).
      Activities from sources enabled this way are processed by the OpenTelemetry
      TracerProvider registered through AddOpenTelemetry().WithTracing().
      Not supported when targeting net10.0.
      (#6899)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Api v1.21.0-rc.1

    No notable changes.

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Api.ProviderBuilderExtensions v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Console v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Fixed byte[]-valued tags being serialized as a JSON array of numbers
      (e.g. [1,2,3]) instead of being Base64-encoded as per the specification.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed array-valued tags containing NaN or infinite floating-point values
      being exported as TRUNCATED; such values are now written as JSON strings
      (e.g. ["NaN"]). Arrays and maps nested inside array-valued tags are now
      written as nested JSON (with byte[] values Base64-encoded) instead of as
      their .NET type name (e.g. System.Int32[]).
      (#7694)

    • Fixed arrays of string-valued key/value pairs being
      serialized as JSON arrays of strings instead of JSON objects.
      (#7694)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Fixed experimental in-memory retries exceeding the export timeout when a
      retried request stalls.
      (#7977)

    • Breaking: The span status description (Activity.StatusDescription or
      the otel.status_description tag) is now truncated to the configured span
      attribute value length limit (for example
      OTEL_SPAN_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_LENGTH_LIMIT) instead of being exported in full.
      (#7995)

    • Redacted nonstandard OTLP endpoint paths in internal diagnostic logs with
      [REDACTED], while retaining standard HTTP and gRPC service paths.
      (#8016)

    • Fixed exports continuing until OtlpExporterOptions.TimeoutMilliseconds
      elapsed when a shorter timeout applied to them, such as the timeout passed
      to MeterProvider.ForceFlush(),
      PeriodicExportingMetricReaderOptions.ExportTimeoutMilliseconds
      (OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_TIMEOUT) or
      BatchExportProcessorOptions<T>.ExporterTimeoutMilliseconds
      (OTEL_BSP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT, OTEL_BLRP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT). The request is now
      canceled when the shorter of the timeouts elapses. The time taken to
      serialize the telemetry now counts towards the timeout, and no request is
      sent once it has elapsed.
      (#7996)

    • Fixed arrays of string-valued key/value pairs being
      exported as arrays of strings instead of maps.
      (#7694)

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Zipkin v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Fixed array-valued tags containing NaN or infinite floating-point values
      being exported as TRUNCATED; such values are now written as JSON strings
      (e.g. ["NaN"]). Arrays and maps nested inside array-valued tags are now
      written as nested JSON (with byte[] values Base64-encoded) instead of as
      their .NET type name (e.g. System.Int32[]).
      (#7694)

    • Fixed arrays of string-valued key/value pairs being
      serialized as JSON arrays of strings instead of JSON objects.
      (#7694)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting v1.21.0-rc.1

    • The OpenTelemetry providers are now initialized in
      IHostedLifecycleService.StartingAsync instead of IHostedService.StartAsync
      so that telemetry emitted by other hosted services during StartingAsync is
      captured. ITelemetryHostInitializer.Initialize() is invoked only once per
      host start.
      (#7998)

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Propagators v1.21.0-rc.1

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.
      (#6899)

    • Add support for .NET 11.0.
      (#6899)

    See CHANGELOG for details.
